tools.name: facts_about
tools.description: Lists the facts static analysis extracted about one entity: those it is the subject of, then those that point to it. Each fact names the file it comes from, which read_file reads.

entity.description: An entity ID as the facts write it, such as service:g:a

predicate.description: Only facts with this predicate, such as endpoint

tools.name: search_facts
tools.description: Finds the facts whose subject, predicate, value, attributes or file hold a text, such as a class, property, path, topic or host name. Each fact names the file it comes from, which read_file reads.

text.description: Text the fact holds, matched ignoring case

predicate.description: Only facts with this predicate, such as endpoint

tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Reads lines of a file of the analyzed repositories at the analyzed commit, with line numbers and secrets masked. Cite the lines it shows as repo:path:from-to.

repo.description: The repository, as a fact's file names it before the :

path.description: The file's path in the repository

to.description: The last line; at most 200 lines a read
